title: Integral Full-Foot Diving Fin
description: One original static full-foot diving-fin appearance, counted as one complete single prop rather than a pair or separate parts. A short curved hollow foot pocket has a real open top entry, complete heel counter, finite walls and closed internal floor and toe. Its lower toe continues through exact shared vertices into a broad flared thin blade with finite tapered thickness and a clipped rounded-looking end. The whole pocket, sole, toe and blade are one continuous closed material mesh; no separate boot or paddle is buried into another surface. All section coordinates, pocket path, opening, blade flare and thickness are newly authored. Generic triangulation, connected-mesh orientation and mature export/render tools are reused, not any old footwear, surfboard, cylinder equipment, paddle profile or scene component. Three opaque untextured matte PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, presentation front -Y, blade toward +Y, full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin and finite flat sole/blade underside. One prop, zero scenes. Stylised fixed visual only: no foot size, fit, donning, comfort, flexibility, motion, thrust, swimming or diving performance, buoyancy, material suitability, manufacturing, compatibility, safety or certification claim. Not functional equipment design or use guidance.
